workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Discover multi-agent workflows, launch runs from the console, and track progress until results land.
workflows.subtitleBoard: Each card is a workflow run — click to open its chat session. Start new runs from the board.
workflows.needToken: Connect to the gateway with a token to browse workflows and monitor runs.
workflows.deleteConfirm: Delete custom workflow "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
workflows.manageDialogHint: Save a JavaScript workflow script to ~/.xopc/workflows/. The filename must match meta.name.
workflows.noDefinitionsHint: Try another filter, or add a custom workflow script under ~/.xopc/workflows/.
workflows.boardEmptyHint: Start a run to create a task card. Progress and results live in the linked chat session.
workflows.boardSucceededCapHint: {{count}} more succeeded runs in the last 7 days are hidden.
workflows.pickStartHint: Pick a workflow template to start a new run.
workflows.taskNoSession: This run has no chat session yet.
workflows.noInputSummary: Uses this workflow's default goal unless you add input below.
workflows.goalPlaceholder: Describe what this run should accomplish…
workflows.noRunsHint: Completed runs appear here with status, duration, artifacts, logs, and subagent output.
workflows.noActiveRunsHint: Start from a template to watch live progress, agent handoffs, logs, and results in this run center.
workflows.selectRunHint: Select a run to inspect phases, subagents, logs, and results.
workflows.runSummaryActive: {{done}}/{{total}} agents have completed. Keep this panel open to follow live progress.
workflows.runSummaryFailedFallback: The run stopped before producing a complete result.
workflows.runSummaryCancelled: This run was cancelled before completion.
workflows.diagnosticFailedHint: Check the failed phase, agent drawer, and logs below; then rerun after adjusting the input or workflow definition.
workflows.diagnosticTimeoutHint: The run hit its time limit. Try lowering concurrency, narrowing the goal, or increasing limits before rerunning.
workflows.diagnosticCancelledHint: No further agents will start. You can rerun when ready.
workflows.diagnosticPartialHint: Some agents reported errors even though the run completed. Review the process tree before acting on the result.
